title: Finding the Tsar's submarine Som and questioning by the Swedish 'FBI'

tellings.quote: wreck we found was 2015. We found the Russian Tsar's submarine, Som. Wow.

plain: A Swedish treasure hunter named Dennis Asberg says that in 2015 his team found the wreck of Som, a submarine of the Russian Tsar's navy from the early 1900s, lost in Swedish waters of the Baltic Sea. He tells Michels he was there for the find, and that afterwards he was questioned in Stockholm by what he calls the Swedish "FBI", the country's security service. He tells it as part of his own history of finding things on the seafloor that draw official attention.
